What happens in the next few minutes of your day decides whether that spend becomes a job or just a number on a bill. This guide covers the part after the ad. mainEntity.name: Do I pay for missed calls from Local Services Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can count. Google says a missed call during your business hours counts as a lead when the customer stays on the line for more than 20 seconds. That is why a clear voicemail greeting and a prompt callback matter.

mainEntity.name: Does not answering calls hurt my Local Services Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can. Google says that if you regularly fail to answer calls or respond to messages, your ad ranking may be affected.

mainEntity.name: Am I charged again if the same customer calls back?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not within the window Google describes. Follow-up calls or messages with that customer are not charged again, provided there is interaction within 15 days and the contact comes from the same phone number or email address.

mainEntity.name: How do I report a bad lead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the Feedback Survey for that lead. Google says leads determined to be invalid or low quality are not charged, and it may occasionally credit leads you report as poor quality through the survey. It does not promise to credit every one.
